cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28.3.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/home/autocookie/pomaieco/dm/src/core/dm_torch/cmake/Modules;/home/autocookie/pomaieco/dm/src/core/dm_torch/cmake/public/../Modules_CUDA_fix;/home/autocookie/pomaieco/dm/src/core/dm_torch/third_party/benchmark/cmake/Modules;/home/autocookie/pomaieco/dm/src/core/dm_torch/third_party/benchmark/cmake")
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE CXX)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS " -fvisibility-inlines-hidden -DUSE_PTHREADPOOL  -Wall  -Wextra  -Wshadow  -Wfloat-equal  -Wold-style-cast  -Wconversion  -Werror  -Wsuggest-override  -pedantic  -pedantic-errors  -fstrict-aliasing  -Wno-deprecated-declarations  -Wno-deprecated  -Wstrict-aliasing")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS " -rdynamic")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
cmake_policy(SET CMP0065 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/home/autocookie/pomaieco/dm/src/core/dm_torch/build_test/CMakeFiles/CMakeTmp")
add_executable(cmTC_27ef5)
target_sources(cmTC_27ef5 PRIVATE
  "/home/autocookie/pomaieco/dm/src/core/dm_torch/third_party/benchmark/cmake/std_regex.cpp"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_27ef5_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_27ef5>)
set_property(TARGET cmTC_27ef5 PROPERTY "CXX_EXTENSIONS" "OFF")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_27ef5 PROPERTY "CXX_STANDARD" "17")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_27ef5 PROPERTY "CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED" "ON")
target_link_libraries(cmTC_27ef5  )
